name: Neuroview
tagline: A free web 3D brain-MRI viewer with synchronised slices and real-time shared annotation.
problem: Medical students learn 3D brain anatomy from flat slices, and good 3D tools are costly.
solution: Loads NIfTI scans, renders a rotatable 3D model with wireframe and threshold controls, syncs axial, sagittal and coronal slices, and supports collaborative annotation.
demo_moment: Team-described: scrub through slices while seeing your position on the 3D model.

lessons: Linking 2D and 3D views is what makes anatomy click.
